experiments.title: Introduce card-based one-link review mode
experiments.problem_detected: The review queue is large relative to the total triaged corpus.
experiments.proposed_ui_change: Add an optional card-based mode showing one candidate link at a time with primary approve/reject/evidence actions.
experiments.expected_effect: Reduce cognitive load and make sequential validation easier than scanning a dense table.

experiments.title: Add source-level summary before link review
experiments.problem_detected: Many pages are possible competition sources but not high-confidence direct evidence.
experiments.proposed_ui_change: Add a source-level summary panel grouping links by university/source URL before row-level review.
experiments.expected_effect: Let reviewers validate or deprioritise whole source clusters before reviewing every individual link.

experiments.title: Create a dedicated unknown-resolution queue
experiments.problem_detected: A large share of links remains in unknown/review-required state.
experiments.proposed_ui_change: Add a saved focus queue for unknown items with explanation prompts and needs-evidence defaults.
experiments.expected_effect: Help reviewers resolve uncertain links without mixing them with likely competition pages.

experiments.title: Strengthen navigation-link suppression
experiments.problem_detected: Navigation-like links are reaching the review queue.
experiments.proposed_ui_change: Update deterministic triage to mark skip/menu/content anchors as likely_not_relevant unless other strong competition signals exist.
experiments.expected_effect: Reduce false positives before they reach manual validation.
